subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the members of the Maison Gardiennage

745170101.text: #Just as we set our strategy and picked our script, the Proto-Boss, {NICKNAME}, makes a grand entrance!

745170102.text: Seriously? You believe in that old saying?

745170103.text: "Sensing the heat of impending battle, the Proto-Boss will appear like a bullet from the dark — to commandeer their troops with ruthless efficiency..."

745170106.text: I see! You mean to say that the velocity of our musket rounds can still be improved... I feel the same way.

745170107.text: #Put a sock in it, Turenna! We got {NICKNAME} to come all this way, so let's get down to business!

745170108.text: Fair enough. Musket talk comes later, then. Now, Proto-Boss, I'm sure you're in top form, ready to lead your troops at any time, right?
